juego.intro: A game for putting your memories in order. Each card has the photo on the front and the date on the back: place it in the memory line where you think it goes, flip it and see if you got it right.
juego.mesaAlt: A game in progress: the memory line in the middle of the table and each player’s cards in front of them, photo side up.
juego.componentesTexto: Your memory cards, the cover card and, if you chose them, 2 jokers and 4 blank cards. Plus a leaflet with these rules.
juego.fechas: Same dates, or just the year
juego.fechasTexto: If two cards have the same date, either order is right. A card with just the year fits anywhere in that year, and one with month and year, on any day of that month.

jugadores.texto: Everyone plays with 7 cards, so it depends on the size of the deck.
jugadores.parejas: More of you? Play in pairs: each pair decides together.

juego.tiposTexto: One deck, two ways to play: everyone with their own cards, or all together.

preparacion: Put the jokers in the middle of the table and the blank cards to one side, with a pen.
Shuffle the memory cards date side down and deal 7 to each player. Lay them out in front of you, photo side up: nobody looks at the dates.
Flip the top card of the deck and put it in the middle, date side up: it starts the memory line. The rest is the draw pile.
If the person who made the deck plays, they get 8 cards: they know the dates better.
The youngest player starts, and play goes clockwise.
turno: Pick one of your cards and place it in the memory line: before all the others, after all of them or between two.
Flip it. If the date fits, the card stays in the line.
If it doesn’t, it goes to the discard pile (a good moment to tell that story) and you draw a card from the deck without looking at the date.
If the draw pile runs out, shuffle the discard pile and keep playing.
final: When someone places their last card correctly, finish the round so everyone gets the same number of turns.
If only one player has run out of cards, they win.
If several have, they play a tiebreak: each draws a card and places it, and anyone who misses is out. If everyone hits or everyone misses, play another round until only one is left.

preparacion: Shuffle the memory cards date side down and deal 7 to each player, photo side up for everyone to see. Nobody looks at the dates.
Put the starting card in the middle, as in Classic, and keep the jokers for the team.
You get as many lives as players with cards, plus one: 3 for 2 players, 4 for 3… Keep count with coins or whatever you have to hand.
If the person who made the deck plays, they don’t get cards: they’re the memory keeper. They answer hints and tell each story when the card is flipped.
The oldest player starts, and play goes clockwise.
turno: Talk it over together, but whoever’s turn it is decides: they place one of their cards in the line and flip it.
If the date fits, the card stays upright.
If it doesn’t, you lose a life. The card goes in its right place, turned sideways: it’s part of your story, but it doesn’t count.
You don’t draw a card when you miss.
final: You win if you place all your cards before losing your last life.
Win or lose, count the upright cards and write down your record to beat next time.
historia.completaTexto: To play with the whole deck, great for two: at the end of each turn, draw back up to 7 cards while the deck lasts. Start with one life for every 8 cards in the deck.
historia.dificultad: Too easy? Start with one life fewer. Too hard? The memory keeper can say “before” or “after” once per card.

mecanicas.texto: Some cards have an icon in the corner. Here’s what each one does.

estrella.clasico: Place it correctly and you play again.
estrella.historia: Place it correctly and you win back a life (never more than you started with).

comodin.clasico: When you miss and end up with more cards than anyone else, take a joker if there’s one left (one each). Use it before placing a card: ask the person who made the deck for a hint (“before or after this card?”) or swap one of your cards for the top card of the deck. Then it goes back in the box. If the deck maker isn’t there, only the swap works.
comodin.historia: They belong to the team and each one can be used once. Before placing a card, ask the memory keeper for a hint (“before or after this card?”) or swap a card for the top card of the deck. With no keeper, only the swap works.

enBlanco.texto: If a memory comes up that isn’t in the deck, write it on a blank card with the date on the back. It joins the next game.

juego.consejo: For your first game, play Our story with the deck maker as memory keeper. For the second, everyone with their own cards.

clasico.resumen: Everyone with their own 7 cards: the first to place them all in the memory line wins.

historia.resumen: All together against the deck: place your cards in the memory line before you run out of lives.
